blind.description: A classical architectural display pedestal or plinth made of cream/beige veined marble. It consists of a stepped square base, a rounded lower collar, a fluted cylindrical shaft, an upper molded collar, and a square flat display surface on top. All surfaces are solid, smooth, and well-modeled with no detached or broken parts.
blind.from_above: A flat square marble surface with faint veining pattern, casting a shadow showing the fluted column profile and square base.
blind.height_vs_figure: About half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 2.5 to 3 feet tall), with a base and top roughly 1.3 feet wide.
